$schema_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for f00 (org f00-sh). Edit this file only, then run: scripts/sync-from-catalog.py. Hub cards, README, and AGENTS.md are derived from here. Theme lives at theme.urls.css.

theme.font_accent: chip/subdomain mono (headers, footers, nav, domain chips)
theme.rule: ONE shared live CSS https://f00.sh/theme/f00-theme.css for hub + every *.f00.sh project site (Worker pins it). Organic poppy-xray field, cool silver chrome, hospital cream boxes with poppy type. Project CSS is layout-only. New projects: enroll-project.py or pin-theme-all-projects.py.

laws.release_to_card: Only projects with status=released get a hub card. Add/update the project entry here when you ship a release.

infra.name: .github
infra.role: Organization profile and community health files

projects.name: f00tils
projects.blurb: Freestanding assembly GNU userland — coreutils, grep, findutils, diffutils. One multicall binary. --core is byte-identical and faster.

projects.name: clun
projects.one_liner: JS/TS toolkit in pure Common Lisp
projects.blurb: JavaScript and TypeScript toolkit. Implementation is pure Common Lisp. Install, test, bundle, serve — Bun-shaped commands, different soul.

projects.name: Cel Index
projects.blurb: Femcel / Incel self-assessment from a formal project model. Transparent factors, optional X priors, shareable score card.

projects.name: TRN
projects.blurb: Enhanced Tabular Recipe Notation — ingredient rows × chronological stages. Cooking for Engineers–style process matrices from any recipe URL or paste.

projects.name: Heartbox
projects.one_liner: Hand-tinted Technicolor dark theme — f00 default brand palette
projects.blurb: Hand-tinted Technicolor dark theme: poppy red, verse-sky blue, hospital gloom, cream light, and cool silver metal. One palette, ports for terminals, editors, and tools. Default f00 brand theme for the hub and every project site.

projects.name: throw
projects.blurb: Structure becomes film; film becomes light on a screen. Emulsion physics and projection chain — not blur filters. f00 looks are throws, not CAD.

projects.name: joule
projects.one_liner: Distributed internet-wide supercomputer cluster: pool idle GPUs into open-weight AI inference (Kimi-class)
projects.blurb: Donate idle GPU cycles to a global volunteer cluster. Earn millijoules. Live dashboard of pool capacity. Open-weight models (Kimi-class). Access only if you contribute.
